title: Will Ariana Grande have above 18M daily views at any point during October 2026?
rules: If Ariana Grande has above 18M Global views on YouTube at any point during October 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
View counts may vary by location. This market will resolve using values displayed from a New York IP address.

Global daily views can be accessed through YouTube Charts by searching for the artist and selecting “Global” as the location.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by YouTube. Any references to YouTube charts or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between YouTube and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Ariana Grande's YouTube Charts daily views peaked at roughly 16M during her tour-finale week in early September 2026, which was a high point that still fell short of 18M. After that, the album cycle (Petal, July 31) was months old, the tour was over, and she announced a step back from visibility, so October views most likely kept falling. Reaching 18M would take a surprise new release or viral spike, and I found none confirmed.
blind.falsifier: A surprise new Ariana Grande music video, single, or viral moment in October 2026 that pushes her YouTube Charts global daily views above 18M on any day.

final.reasoning: My 5% estimate is below the 0.115 midpoint, but the spread is very wide. Taking NO at 0.98 would cost more than my estimated NO value of about 0.95, so there is no positive-value trade.
